tasks.objective: Make the deduction list returned by compute_pay deterministic by sorting it by name in payroll/calc.py, and add a unit test in tests/test_payroll.py that asserts the exact sorted tuple list for employees e1 and e2, so every consumer of compute_pay gets a stable order.

concepts: compute_pay return shape: {gross: float, deductions: [(name, amount)], net: float}
name-sorted order replaces insertion order: 'insurance' precedes 'tax'
existing values are pinned by tests: e1 gross 8000.0, tax 1600.0, insurance 400.0, net 6000.0

forbidden_scope: payroll/legacy_export.py (read-only; HR-4411 byte format, do not extend or refactor)
tests/test_payslip_summary.py, tests/test_contract_shape.py, tests/test_payslip_integration.py (owned by other tasks)
inputs: employee fixture records e1/e2 in payroll/employees.py
outputs: payroll/calc.py with the name-sorted deductions list
tasks.split_rationale: The deterministic-order closure is calc.py plus its test file plus the two read-only downstream readers (payslip.py, legacy_export.py); the change and its test stay one leaf because splitting them would make two agents re-learn the same 19-line module (shared-context benefit, one layer, one contract).

tasks.objective: Add the final summary line to render_payslip's output in the exact format 'Summary: net=<net> gross=<gross> deductions=<total>' with 2-decimal values, and create tests/test_payslip_summary.py that asserts the exact line for employees e1 and e2.

concepts: render_payslip returns list[str]; the summary line is appended as the last element after the 'Net:' line
f-string 2-decimal formatting :.2f for net, gross, and the deductions total
total = sum of all deduction amounts; order-independent

forbidden_scope: payroll/calc.py (owned by T01; the summary line must not change the calculation)
payroll/legacy_export.py (no summary line in the XML; HR-4411 byte format)
inputs: frozen contract C2 spec (the exact summary-line format, stage-contract.json)
frozen contract C1 spec (the pay shape the summary is computed from)
employee fixture records e1/e2 in payroll/employees.py
outputs: payroll/payslip.py rendering the exact summary line as the final list element
tests/test_payslip_summary.py (new) with exact-format tests for e1 and e2
tasks.split_rationale: The summary line is a presentation closure inside payslip.py with its own new test file; it consumes only the frozen C1 shape (the total is order-independent), so it can run in parallel with T01 on disjoint owned paths instead of serializing behind the calc change.
